visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short dark hair and glasses speaks directly to the camera, wearing a white high-neck top and a grey embellished cardigan. She points her index finger to her cheek, illustrating a specific facial area while standing against a dark grey curtain background in a studio setting. (2) The camera moves closer to her face as she uses both hands to pull and lift the skin on her lower cheeks, demonstrating sagging. Her facial expressions are animated and informative. (3) She gestures toward the area from her ear down to her jawline with her fingers, explaining anatomical locations. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting her skin texture and movements. (4) She places her hands on her temples and the upper outer contours of her face, pulling the skin upwards to show the desired lifting effect. Yellow and white variety-style text overlays appear on the screen periodically. (5) The video transitions to a white graphic screen displaying the clinic's logo, social media handles, phone number, and physical addresses for multiple locations, framed by soft grey artistic swirls.
